entryAndProgression: Current2026–2027 BVG profile and Dutch programme confirm a Dutch-taught, full-time three-year bachelor, linking nutrition/lifestyle to biochemical, physiological, biomedical, behavioural/social and population-level mechanisms. No formal specialisation is required or invented. The English website and API EN/NL tags do not establish an English-language alternate bachelor.

MAT15403 explicitly accepts active high-school statistics/MathA or MAT15303; MAT24306 builds on MAT15403/basic statistics. Raw required flags alone do not override the group’s conditional rule.

YNH80312 and programme LC require at least102credits of compulsory first-/second-year study, all60B1 and the module specifically adds YNH10301 Skills Development Part1. Complete all B1/B2 courses and Part1 before thesis, satisfying the stronger module wording. Part2/motivation can also precede it; Part3 is completed with the thesis/electives and is not falsely demanded in advance. Research Methodology I/II and other curriculum preparation are considered, without inventing a different hard prerequisite.

Thesis is an individual literature study in nutrition/biomedical health: critical analysis, question/plan, written scientific report, proposal and final presentations, final discussion, workshops/thesis rings/kickoff and supervisor interview/report. Current assessment metadata gives research competence30%, report50%, presentation10%, final discussion10%, each minimum5.50; interview report is pass/fail and required activities remain completion conditions. No old guide or experimental thesis is substituted.

YNH81306 optional extension requires laboratory safety and combination with YNH80312 at the same research group, with150hours participation and reflective oral assessment. It is not selected and not added to180; its availability does not make a laboratory thesis mandatory.

General and laboratory safety are zero-credit obligations. Laboratory safety precedes the named chemical/biological/physiological/nutrition practicals. Physiological systems precede integrated physiology; macronutrients precede metabolic nutrition. All named current module MK/AK/link and assessment records were inspected; advisory preparation is kept distinct from hard requirements.

Current HNH25806 designs nutrition protocols including allocation, blinding, compliance, measurement validity and ethics. HNH26306 conducts an actual dietary intervention with body composition, intake/energy/biomarkers, physiological/immunological/sensory and nutrigenetic methods and scientific reporting. Measuring Dietary Intake covers instruments, reference values, biomarkers and measurement error; Food Technology covers processing/storage and nutrient function/digestibility. These are specialist substantive requirements, not generic research labels.

Current programme explicitly lists Biotechnology and Data Science as possible freely chosen minors, not compulsory study directions. Retain that permitted generator evidence with the correct optional context. Molecular/experimental candidate is also supported by central biomedical interests. Own DataScience separately after the three-programme maximum, rather than pretending the behavioural plan implements a full DataScience direction.

Current catalogue and module rules sufficiently establish the coherent pathway and thesis progression; no redundant OER or historical thesis-guide requirement imposed. The2019-style search lead was not used to override current102credit/Part1 requirements. No unavailable source supports approval.

The inspected NMG education page mixes bachelor/master offerings and its Brightspace guidance is expressly for MSc theses/internships. It corroborates the research domain but does not make its advanced nutrigenomics/immunometabolism courses compulsory in BVG or impose an unavailable MSc guide on the bachelor. Current BVG modules alone define the credited pathway.

A 'resit' for performance and report, is possible by improving the research and/or report . The course coordinator will set the new date for this after consultation with student and supervisor.  For a resit of the presentation or defence, a new appointment is made between student and course coordinator, resp supervisor.
